o.text:
From Proto-Turkic *seč- (“to choose, select”).
Cognate with Old Turkic [script needed] (seç-, “to choose, discern”), Turkish seçmek (“to choose, distinguish”), Turkmen seçmek (“to choose”), Yakut эс- (es-, “throw away”).
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish بركتمك (berkitmek, “to strengthen”), from برك (berk, “healthy, sound, strong”). By surface analysis, bərki- + -t
